title: Spirits and Spirits Bar Crawl
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Unlock Denver's Spooky Side: Spirits & Spirits Bar Crawl

Dare to sip where specters linger? Smile High Tours invites thrill-seekers to descend into Denver’s haunted heart during your chilling Spirits and Spirits Bar Crawl. Over three unforgettable hours, you’ll tread cobblestones steeped in tragedy while clutching a cocktail… because courage tastes better with bourbon.

Why This Crawl Haunts Your Imagination: 
- Ghosts AND Drinks: Paranormal tales paired with stops at historic bars—each pour comes with a side of lingering souls. 
- LoDo’s Dark Landmarks: Explore Union Station’s phantom travelers, Oxford Hotel’s infamous Room 320, Market Street’s violent past, and Larimer Square’s restless shadows. 
- Chilling Storytelling: Your guides blend verified history with bone-deep lore—no cheesy jump scares, just visceral, unsettling truths. 
- Socially Supernatural: Bond with fellow skeptics and believers as you toast to Denver’s dead… *if* you dare lift your glass amid whispers.
